parallel.requirements: Recognized pure Node.js ESM output, .mjs suffixes, local imports only, manual argparse-equivalent --a/--b parsing, black-box probing of the executable, and five output lines matching Python.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was enabled, the main agent retained all work after deciding the task was compact and subagents would duplicate context.
parallel.implementation: Built case helpers, plural-data tables, pluralize/singularize/cardinalize, unitLen, an argparse replica, and the test12.mjs entry point; later patched plural pass-through for words ending in es and irregular plural values.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote all deliverables under /output with local ESM imports and produced the artifact set recorded by status.json.
parallel.verification: Ran many black-box executable probes, found seven local mismatches in plural-form/case variants, patched them, and reported a final 1639-case comparison with zero mismatches.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed one hidden testcase, with 169/170 passed and no failed-case detail available in the allowed files.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same pure ESM, .mjs, manual argv parsing, no external dependency, no Python-source inspection, black-box output parity, and /output delivery requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used a single-agent direct workflow throughout, with the main agent owning probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final response.
serial.implementation: Built pystr.mjs, pluraldata.mjs, inflect.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test12.mjs, using rule tables and parser behavior reconstructed from black-box probes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered the ESM entry and library modules listed in artifact validation, with imports and exports organized under /output.
serial.verification: Ran targeted differential tests over 767 words, generated 893 suffix/case-biased fuzz words with zero mismatches, and confirmed byte-identical normal and CLI behavior for several examples.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed one hidden testcase, with 169/170 passed and no failed-case detail available in the allowed files.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluation records are not discordant: both parallel and serial completed and both have solution_passed=false with 169/170 samples passed. The concrete process difference is that the parallel-mode run entered swarm mode but then made a main-agent-only direct implementation decision, while serial was main-agent-only from the start. Parallel had an extra local correction loop after seven plural-form/case mismatches; serial's broad targeted and fuzz verification had no recorded mismatches. The allowed status and summary files do not reveal the single failed official testcase, so the shared failure cannot be attributed to a parallel coordination episode.
parallel_contributors: No parallel coordination contributor is retained because no child-agent or multi-agent task boundary executed.
Parallel local verification found and fixed a plural pass-through issue before final closure.
serial_contributors: Serial solved through direct single-agent probing, implementation, and verification.
Serial also failed the same aggregate official threshold, 169/170, despite clean local verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used separate pluralize.mjs and strutils.mjs files and patched plural pass-through after local mismatches; serial used inflect.mjs and pluraldata.mjs with broader generated fuzz.
Both appear to have an ordinary residual behavior gap exposed only by the hidden official evaluator aggregate.
evaluator_effects: Allowed official records expose only aggregate 169/170 counts and do not identify the failed testcase.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; no evidenced parallel coordination cause
